TYPE.LABEL: Bot type
TYPE.WEBHOOK_DESCRIPTION: Sends conversation events to your service, which replies through the API.
TYPE.AI_AGENT_DESCRIPTION: Answers visitors from its knowledge base and website pages, and hands the conversation to your team when it cannot.

MODEL.LABEL: Model
MODEL.HELP: Leave blank to use the model of the OpenAI integration.

AI_AGENT.DEFAULT_TEXT_HELP: Leave blank to use the default text shown in the field.

HANDOFF_TEAM.LABEL: Handoff team
HANDOFF_TEAM.HELP: Conversations the bot can't answer go to this team. With none, any member of the inbox can pick them up.

REPLY_LIMIT.LABEL: Reply limit
REPLY_LIMIT.HELP: Bot replies in one conversation before it hands the conversation to the team, from 1 to 200. Leave blank to use the default.
REPLY_LIMIT.ERROR: Enter a whole number from 1 to 200

FALLBACK_MESSAGE.LABEL: Fallback message
FALLBACK_MESSAGE.HELP: Sent when the bot fails to reply or reaches the reply limit, right before it hands off. Leave blank to use the default text.
